summary: Sony Cambridge's gothic action-adventure series, covering the original PlayStation games, the PSP reimagining, and the PS4 remake.

entries.title: MediEvil

emulation.emulator: PlayStation Classics emulator on PS4/PS5; DuckStation for owned original discs
emulation.notes: Use the PS4/PS5 classic for official up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and filters.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PlayStation presentation with official up-rendering and emulator conveniences.

primary.why: The PS4/PS5 classic conversion is the best official way to play the original MediEvil because it preserves the PlayStation game while adding up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.
primary.how_to_play: Buy or access MediEvil on the PlayStation Store/PlayStation Plus Premium and play on PS5 or PS4. Use the PS4 remake as a separate remake entry, not as the same game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not conflate the original with MediEvil: Resurrection or the 2019 remake; both are separate reimaginings/remakes.

entries.title: MediEvil: Resurrection

emulation.emulator: PlayStation Classics emulator on PS4/PS5; PPSSPP for owned PSP copies
emulation.notes: Use the PS4/PS5 classic for official up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and filters.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PSP presentation with official up-rendering and emulator conveniences.

primary.why: The PS4/PS5 classic conversion is the best official route for MediEvil: Resurrection because it preserves the PSP reimagining while adding up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

entries.remaster_caveats: Resurrection is a PSP reimagining of the first MediEvil, not the same entry as the 1998 original or the 2019 PS4 remake.

entries.title: MediEvil

emulation.notes: No emulation needed beyond PS5 backward compatibility.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PS4 remake presentation, enhanced by PS4 Pro/PS5 output where applicable.

primary.why: The 2019 MediEvil is a full PS4 remake of the original PlayStation action-adventure, with new visuals and reimagined classic gameplay; it is a separate remake entry rather than the same version as the PS1 classic.
primary.how_to_play: Play the PS4 version natively on PS4 or via backward compatibility on PS5.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a remake/reimagining of the original MediEvil, so keep it separate from the PS1 enhanced classic.
